[ S. grāma] ( pl. acc. occasionally gāmāni), 1. an inhabited place; a village; the people of a village ; Abh 225 (~o saṃvasatho); 1107; Vin I 39, 3 (yaṃ assa ~ato n’ eva avidūre na accāsanne); 207, 38 (pañca ārāmikasatāni pādāsi, pāṭiyekko ~o nivisi); III 26, 17 (~o me atthi tena pāhaṃ jīvissāmī ti); 46, 23 foll. (~o nāma ekakuṭiko pi ~o dvikuṭiko pi ~o … yo pi sattho atirekacatumāsaniviṭṭho so pi vuccati ~o); 184, 9 (bhikkhu … aññataraṃ ~aṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati); D II 337, 12 (majjhe ~assa ṭhito tikkhattuṃ saṅkhaṃ upaḷāsitvā); III 255, 28 (bhikkhu ~aṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto); S I 69, 17* (~e vā yadi vāraññe yattha passe bhujaṅgamaṃ); 123, 3* (āguṃ nu ~asmiṃ akāsi kiñci); 200, 29 (āyasmā Nāgadatto atikālena ~aṃ pavisati atidivā paṭikkamati); Dhp 47 (suttaṃ ~aṃ mahogho va maccu ādāya gacchati); Sn 118 (yo hanti parirundhati ~āni nigamāni ca); 619 (yo hi koci manussesu ~aṃ raṭṭhaṃ ca bhuñjati … rājā eso na brāhmaṇo); 683 (so bodhisatto … jāto Sakyānaṃ ~e janapade Lumbineyye); Th 14 (~e me vasati kāyo araññaṃ me gato mano); Ja IV 362, 17* (~amhi ca vanamhi ca); 364, 1* (nikkhantabhikkhaṃ bhuñjanti ~esv eke purohitā); V 98, 28 (gāmaṭṭhāne ~o nāma nāhosi); Ap 349, 7 (~e vā yadi vāraññe pabbhāresu guhāsu vā); Mil 47, 19 (gharaṃ jhāyamānaṃ ~aṃ jhāpeyya); Sp 1012, 28 (sakalena kulena vā ~ena vā anuññātaṃ hoti); Ps III 330, 20 (~o osaritvā nigame aṭṭhāsi, nigamo nagare …); Pj I 17, 33 (na h’ ettha ajaṃ ~aṃ netī ti ādisu viya dvikammakattaṃ akkharacintakā icchanti); Cp-a 97, 13 (koci puriso kassaci santike ~aṃ vā janapadaṃ vā keniyā gahetvā); Mhv 6:22 (ubbāsīyati so so ca yaṃ yaṃ ~aṃ upeti so); — ifc see gocara- ( sv go ), jāta- ( sv √jan ), tiro-, dhura-, nigama- ( sv nigama 1 ), nivāsana- ( sv nivāsana 2 ), paccanta-, padvāra-; — 2. a class, a collection ; Abh 1107 (gaṇe ~o); Sp 761, 9 (~o ti rāsi, bhūtānaṃ ~o ti bhūtagāmo, bhūtā eva vā ~o bhūtagāmo); Paṭis-a 690, 14 (bhūtānaṃ ~o ti pi bhūtagāmo ti vadanti); — ifc see bīja-, bhūta-, mātu-; — 3. a musical scale ; Mp III 390, 3* (satta sarā tayo ~ā mucchanā ekavīsati ṭhānā ekūnapaññāsaṃ icc ete saramaṇḍalaṃ; Mp-ṭ [Be] III 120, 26 : chajjagāmo majjhimagāmo sādhāraṇagāmo ti tayo ~ā, samūhā ti attho); — ifc see chajja-, majjhima-, sādhāraṇa-; — gāme in Ee, Se at Sp 1165, 3 (gacchato gāme) is prob. wr; Be, Ce gacchato me; — °’- anta , m. [gāma + anta 1 ], the neighbourhood of a village; a village ; Vin III 171, 19 (sādhu bhante bhikkhū yāvajīvaṃ āraññakā assu, yo ~aṃ osareyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyya); D I 73, 6 (so … taṃ kantāraṃ nitthareyya sotthinā ~aṃ anupāpuṇeyya khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ); S IV 37, 11 ; Sn 710 (tato ratyā vivasane ~am abhihāraye); Th 962 (kicchantā vana-patthāni ~esu vasissare; Th-a III 87, 6 : ~esū ti gāmanta-senāsanesu gāmasamīpesu senāsanesu gāmadvāresu vā senāsanesu); Ja I 154, 12 (tvaṃ kho si ayya pabbateyyo bālamigo ~o ca nāma sāsaṅko sappaṭibhayo); Vism 115, 16 (~aṃ osaritvā gihīhi saṃsaṭṭho hutvā); Ps I 248, 4 (itthipurisahatthi-assādisaddasamākulaṃ ~aṃ apariccajitvā); — °’- antaka , n. [gāma + antaka 2 ; cf S. grāmāntika], the neighbourhood of a village; a village ; Ja II 40, 17* (~āni sevassu etaṃ mātālayaṃ tava, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce gāmantikāni; 40, 20´ foll. : etaṃ gāmantaṃ ukkāraṭṭhānaṃ āmakasusānaṭṭhānaṃ ca tava mātu ālayaṃ gehaṃ vāsanaṭṭhānaṃ tattha gacchā ti); — °’- antara , n. and mfn. , 1. ( n. ) another village, a different village; the next village ; Vin IV 62, 30 (yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso ~aṃ pi pācittiyan ti; 63, 28 : kukkuṭasampāte gāme ~e ~e āpatti pācittiyassa; Sp 806, 27 foll. : anantaragāmassa upacārokkamane pana bhikkhuno pācittiyaṃ); 227, 33 (bhikkhunī ekā ~aṃ gacchatī ti); Sp 807, 21 (~e cetiyavandanatthaṃ gāmato nikkhamantaṃ bhikkhuṃ disvā); Ps II 258, 21 (dve tīṇi ~āni vā aṭaviṃ vā vicaranto); Vin-vn 2033 (~aṃ nadīpāraṃ gaccheyy’ ekā); — 2. ( mfn. ) relating to (going to) another village ; Sp 1185, 12 (ahaṃ ayye ekaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjiṃ ~aṃ, sāhaṃ ayye saṅghaṃ ekissā āpattiyā ~āya pakkhamānattaṃ yācāmī ti); — ~-kappa, m. , “different village practice”, the practice of eating a second time in a different village ; Vin II 300, 33 foll. (ko so āvuso ~-kappo ti kappati bhante idāni ~aṃ gamissāmī ti bhuttāvinā pavāritena anatirittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjitun ti n’ āvuso kappatī ti); — °’- ū̆pacāra , m. , the environs, the outskirts, of a village ; Vin I 110, 1 (ṭhapetvā gāmaṃ ca ~aṃ ca); III 46, 27 (~o nāma parikkhittassa gāmassa indakhīle ṭhitassa majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto, aparikkhittassa gāmassa gharūpacāre ṭhitassa majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto); Ja II 440, 9 (bodhisatto ekasmiṃ ~e eraṇḍarukkhadevatā hutvā nibbatti); Sp 1050, 17 (~o ti parikkhittassa parikkhepo); — °- kamma , n. , village work, village affairs ; Ja I 199, 10 (te ca tiṃsakulamanussā ekadivasaṃ gāmamajjhe ṭhatvā ~aṃ karonti); Sv 710, 27 (~-karaṇaṭṭhānaṃ); — °- kūṭa , °-kūṭaka, m. , a magistrate, a village chief (with a connotation of dishonesty?) ; Vin III 100, 19* (°-kūṭako, in uddāna); 106, 35 (eso … satto imasmiṃ yeva Rājagahe ~o ahosi; Sp 510, 6 : ~o ti vinicchayāmacco); Ja IV 179, 3´ (kūṭavedī ti kūṭajānanako ~o vā lokassa anatthakārako vā …, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be °-kūṭako); Spk I 116, 5 (yathā gāme ~ā nānappakārena janaṃ pīḷetvā); — °- (k)khetta , n. , village land or territory; a village field ; Vin II 185, 26 (tassa evarūpo attabhāvapaṭilābho hoti seyyathā pi nāma dve vā tīṇi vā Māgadhakāni ~āni) = A III 122, 26 (Mp III 277, 13 foll. ); D I 117, 3 (ye … keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā amhākaṃ ~aṃ āgacchanti atithī no te honti); II 166, 1 (bhagavā amhākaṃ ~e parinibbuto); M III 10, 11 (te mayaṃ tadahuposathe yāvatikā ekaṃ ~aṃ upanissāya viharāma, te sabbe ekajjhaṃ sannipatāma); Thī 340 (hitvān’ ahaṃ … ~āni phītāni); Ap 124, 9 (gāmaṃ ca ~aṃ vā sahassaṃ vā labheyya ’haṃ); — °- gāmika , m. [gāma + gāmika 2 ], a village headman ; A III 76, 22 (yadi vā ~assa yadi vā pūgagāmaṇikassa, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be °-gāmaṇikassa; Mp III 261, 15 : gāmānaṃ gāmikassa, gāmasāmikassā ti attho, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se gāmānaṃ gāmaṇikassa); 300, 9 (~o pūgagāmaṇiko, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-gamaṇiko; Mp III 350, 25 : gāmabhojako); — °- ghāta , m. and m ( fn )., 1. ( m. ) plundering of a village; marauding ; D I 135, 8 (janapado sakaṇṭako sa-upapīḷo ~ā pi dissanti); Ja IV 435, 15´ (ālopā ti divā ~ā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~o); Kv 173, 32 (arahā aññāṇapakato … ~aṃ kareyya); 622, 14 (ekādhippāyena … ~o kātabbo, Ee so; Be, Se °-ghātako); Sp 997, 15 (yo ~aṃ … karonto vicarati); — 2. ( m [ fn ].) (one) who plunders a village; a marauder ; S II 188, 21 (dīgharattaṃ vo … corā ~ā ti gahetvā sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ pasannaṃ paggharitaṃ, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se °-ghātakā ti); — °- ghātaka , m ( fn ). and m. , 1. ( m [ fn ].) [gāma + ghātaka 1 ] (one) who plunders a village; a marauder ; S IV 173, 30 (imaṃ suññagāmaṃ corā ~ā pavisanti, Be so; Ce, Ee vadhissanti; Se °-ghātā pavisanti); Mil 20, 19 (te pubbe ~ā corā); Vism 505, 26 ; — 2. ( m. ) [gāma + ghātaka 2 ] the plundering of a village; marauding ; Ja I 200, 3 (bahū corā ~’-ādīni karontā vicarantī ti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-ghātādīni); Ud-a 179, 18 ; It-a II 53, 34 ; — °- jeṭṭhaka , m. , a village headman ; Abh 920; Ja II 136, 8´ (ambho ~a); IV 311, 13´ (gāmaṇī ti ~o); — °- tā , f. , a group of villages ; Sadd 789, 22 (janānaṃ samūho janatā evaṃ … ~ā); — °- tthakanaka , mfn. , closing up a village, being the gate of a village ; Sp 281, 6 (~aṃ cakkalakayuttadvāraṃ); — °- dhamma 1 , m. [gāma + dhamma 1 ], the rule or customs of a village ; Ap 566, 15 (na ~o na nigamassa dhammo na cāpi yaṃ ekakulassa dhammo, sabbassa lokassa sadevakassa eso va dhammo yad idaṃ aniccatā); — °- nissandhena in Ee at Vism 250, 10 is wr for °-nissandena ( Be, Ce, Se , Vibh-a 233, 4 so ); — °- paṭṭa , °- paṭṭana , °-pada, °-paddhana, n. (?), the site of a village ;? D II 349, 30 (te yena so janapado yen’ aññataraṃ °-paṭṭaṃ ten’ upasaṅkamiṃsu, Be so; Ce °-patthaṃ; Ee °-paddhanaṃ; Se °-pajjaṃ; Sv 812, 27 : °-paṭṭan ti vuṭṭhitagāmappadeso vuccati, °-padan ti pi pāṭho, ayaṃ ev’ attho, Be so; Ce °-paṭṭanan ti; Ee °-paddhanan ti; Se °-pajjan ti; Sv-pṭ II 449, 20 : °-pattan ti gāmo eva hutvā āpajjitabbaṃ, suññabhāvena anāmasitabbaṃ, Ee so ; Be anāvasitabbaṃ); — °- pati , m. [gāma + pati 2 ], a village chief; a squire ; Ja II 136, 5* (taṃ taṃ ~i brūmi; 136, 8´ : ambho gāmajeṭṭhaka); — °- patikā , f. , the site of a village ;? the wife of a village chief ;? Ud-a 122, 14 (tassa avidūre ekā ~ā ahosi, sā pi tassa yakkhassa āṇāpavattiṭṭhāne niviṭṭhattā ten’ evaṃ ca paripālitattā Kuṇḍiyā ti vohārīyittha, Be, Se so; Ce vāmapatikā; Ee āṇāpitaṭṭhāne); — °- poddava , °-pūṭava, m. or mfn. , (according to ct) (one) given to bodily embellishment ; Vin II 105, 9 (kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā nahāyamānā rukkhe kāyaṃ ugghaṃsessanti … seyyathā pi mallamuṭṭhikā ~ā ti, Ce, Ee so; Be °-moddavā; Se °-pūṭavā ti; Sp 1199, 15 : °-pūṭavā ti chavirāgamaṇḍanānuyuttā nāgarikamanussā, °-potakā ti pi pāṭho, es’ ev’ attho, Ee, Se so; Be °-muddavā ti … °-moddavā ti pi pāṭho; Ce gāmupaddavā ti … ~ā ti pi pāṭho); — °- bandhana , n. , restraint in a village, restriction to a village ; Vin III 47, 10 (bandheyyuṃ vā ti rajjubandhanena vā … nagara-bandhanena vā ~ena vā …); Nidd I 403, 3 (taṃ enaṃ rājā bandhāpeti … ~ena vā nagarabandhanena vā; Nidd-a I 354, 35 : ~enā ti ādisu tasmā tasmā ṭhānato nikkhamituṃ alabhanto ~’-ādīhi baddho nāma hoti); Kv 272, 12 (labbhā arahato kāyo … ~ena bandhituṃ nigamabandhanena bandhituṃ …); — °- bhojaka , m. , a village chief (who lives off the village); a squire ; Ja I 199, 27 (~o cintesi ahaṃ pubbe … daṇḍabalivasena ca dhanaṃ labhāmi); II 134, 24 (tassa bhariyā dussīlā ~ena saddhiṃ anācāraṃ carati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee gāmabhojanakena, prob. wr ); Ps II 252, 8 (janapade uppanno aṭṭo ~aṃ pāpuṇāti); Dhp-a I 69, 5 ; Sadd 471, 9 (mahībhujo ~o …); — °- vāsi(n) , mf ( n ). [gāma + vāsi(n) 2 ], (one) who lives in a village; a villager ; Ja I 480, 18 (~ino sakkaccaṃ tāpasaṃ upaṭṭhahanti); Vism 96, 33 ; Sv 72, 14 (gāmadhammā ti ~īnaṃ dhammā); Ps I 74, 25 (~ī puriso); Mp I 143, 9 (~īhi saddhiṃ); Dhp-a III 89, 7 (~ī bhattagandhaṃ ghāyitvā va nagaravāsiṃ āha); — °- vāsika , mf ( n )., (one) who lives in a village; a villager ; Ja I 221, 7 (āvuso mayaṃ ~ā dullabhapaccayā); 297, 1 (corā … ~ehi yeva bhaṇḍikā ukkhipāpetvā); Vism 706, 17 (~ā sannipatitvā … āhaṃsu); Mp III 360, 17 (gamman ti ~ānaṃ dassanaṃ); — agāma , m. and mfn. , 1. ( m. ) not a village; an uninhabited place ; M II 97, 27 (coro Aṅgulimālo hoti … tena gāmā pi ~ā katā); A I 159, 33 (manussānaṃ khayo hoti tanuttaṃ paññāyati gāmā pi ~ā honti); Sp 482, 12 ; 1050, 31 (manussā … aññattha gatā, ~o yeva esa); — 2. ( mfn. ) without a village, not having a village ; Ja V 99, 28* (bahū hi khattiyā jīnā atthaṃ raṭṭhaṃ pamādino atho pi gāmino ’gāmā anāgārā agārino, perhaps so read ? eds gāmino gāmā; cf 101, 4´ foll. : atthaṃ raṭṭhan ti janapadavāsīnaṃ vuddhiṃ c’ eva sakalaraṭṭhaṃ ca bahū pamādino jīnā … gāmino ti gāmabhojakā pi te gāmā pi bahū pamādadosena jīnā parihīnā vinaṭṭhā, anāgārā agārino ti pabbajitā pi pabbajitapaṭipattito gihī pi gharāvāsato c’ eva dhanadhaññādīhi ca bahū jīnā parihīnā ti attho, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee gāmino ti gāma-bhojakā pi te te gāmino bahupamādadosena …); — see also agāmaka.
NCP: neuter | gaamapa.t.ta the site of a village.
